Subject: Follow-up: rerank model fit discussion & pilot plan

Mike — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we all have the same thing in writing.

Recap (from our call)
- Objective: improve store search relevance for product list pages and category landing queries; primary metric = NDCG@10 secondary = MRR.
- Key constraints: sub-200ms P95 for user-facing rerank path, data privacy (no raw customer emails), and a pilot limited to ~5% traffic while we validate.

Offline model-fit highlights (holdout sample OptiShop provided)
- Baseline current ranker: NDCG@10 = 0.312, MRR = 0.245
- Redwood candidate A (re-ranker-l3-small, quantized int8): NDCG@10 = 0.378 (+21%), MRR = 0.291 (+19%)
- Redwood candidate B (re-ranker-l4-base, fp16): NDCG@10 = 0.392 (+25%), MRR = 0.305 (+24%)
- Latency estimate (in our Hosted environment): r3-small median token latency ~12ms, end-to-end rerank median = 85ms; r4-base median = 28ms, end-to-end rerank = 130ms.

Attachments included: optishop-offline-ndcg-mrr-20260927.pdf (summary), optishop-sample-prompts-20260927.jsonl (sample prompt sets), optishop-mutual-action-plan-OPTI-452.xlsx

Proposed next steps / asks for OptiShop
1) Approve a small live canary A/B pilot: 5% of Search traffic for 14 days. We’ll split 50/50 between Baseline and Candidate A (quantized) initially.
2) Provide a 24–48h S3 sample of production queries and result contexts (anonymized) if possible — we used the holdout you already shared but need a slightly different time window to avoid leakage.
3) Confirm logging constraints: we will only store non-PII features (query text + SKU ids) per your policy. Let us know if you require an on-prem/private deployment instead of Hosted for the pilot.

Monitoring & rollback thresholds (proposal)
- Safety: if NDCG@10 drops by >3% vs baseline for 48h OR user CTR on searched items drops >4% relative, auto-rollback.
- Latency: if P95 > 200ms for 1h, auto-rollback.

Tentative timeline
- Sign-off on data + pilot config: 2–3 business days
- Canary start: within 3 business days of sign-off
- Pilot duration: 14 days

Questions from our side
- Can you confirm the sample S3 path and who on your team will approve the data share?
- Any procurement/PO hurdles we should expect before the pilot?

I’ve cc’d Ben (AE) and Marissa (ML engineer) — Marissa will own the eval instrumentation and will propose the exact A/B rollout steps. I’ll attach the mutual action plan in the next message.

—

Hi Mike / Priyom — quick technical notes from the eval side and the A/B recipe we recommend.

Prompt sets & evals
- We prepared three prompt families in optishop-sample-prompts-20260927.jsonl:
  * Query-only rerank (baseline): score documents given query + doc embeddings
  * Query + context (session history): test for intent shifts
  * Diversified re-rank (penalize near-duplicate SKU clusters)
- Please confirm which families you want in the live pilot. We recommend starting with Query-only rerank for minimal risk.

Model & quantization tradeoffs
- Candidate A (r3-small int8): best cost / latency balance; risk: slightly lower contextual sensitivity vs fp16.
- Candidate B (r4-base fp16): higher lift in offline but +40% latency and ~2.5x cost. Consider B in expansion phase only.

A/B plan (technical)
- Step 1 (canary ramp): 2% traffic for 24h (50/50 Baseline/Candidate A) with real-time telemetry.
- Step 2: if all green, increase to 5% for 14 days. Collect NDCG@10, MRR, CTR per segment (mobile/desktop/new/returning).
- Step 3: after day 7, compute statistical significance for NDCG@10 uplift (bootstrap CI). If p < 0.05 and no metric regressions, recommend expansion to 20% to test Candidate B.

Monitoring hooks & logs
- We’ll surface: NDCG@10, MRR, search CTR, P95 latency, server errors, and per-query distribution of rank changes.
- On privacy: we will hash all session ids and only persist query + SKU hash. If you prefer, we can use a private deployment for additional controls.

Operational notes
- KV/prefix caching: we’ll keep KV-key TTL short (5s) to avoid staleness while reducing token cost for frequent queries.
- Regression guardrails: automatic rollback if NDCG@10 falls by >3% for 48h OR if P95 > 200ms for 1h.

Next actionable items from OptiShop
1) Share pre-signed S3 path for sanitized sample.
2) Confirm you’re ok with the proposed logging / hashing approach.
3) Approve the mutual action plan (I attached the current draft).

I’ll upload the initial Redwood Console dashboard and the evaluation notebook once we get the S3 link.

—
